fields.name: save_counter
fields.description: Save sequence counter. Slot select is counter&1 and the counter is incremented after each successful write.
fields.evidence: FUN_08001bfc writes EEPROM slot (0, *buf & 1) then does *buf = *buf + 1 on success; FUN_08001b70 loads both slots and prefers slot1 when (ushort)(ctr1 - ctr0) < 0x40. Baseline: slot0=0, slot1=1. Slot0 span [0x000,0x100).

fields.name: save_counter_backup
fields.description: Save sequence counter. Slot select is counter&1 and the counter is incremented after each successful write. (redundant slot1 copy).
fields.evidence: FUN_08001bfc writes EEPROM slot (0, *buf & 1) then does *buf = *buf + 1 on success; FUN_08001b70 loads both slots and prefers slot1 when (ushort)(ctr1 - ctr0) < 0x40. Baseline: slot0=0, slot1=1. Slot1 mirror at [0x100,0x200); FUN_08001b70 verifies both slots and picks the newer counter.
